[u][b]ABOUT MOD:[/b][/u]

[b]Its very hard option of Community Center Bundles for 1 year challenge (but not only - I bet some of casual players can't do it in 2 years).
Click to show have much and what you need to finish CC -> [url=https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1Fl0tUSoNhhWuYMwYsTO5xO6BwnFL3UzBdPFXSEiJVZg/edit#gid=0]Google doc
[/url](yellow quality crops need gold crops).

[/b]Ver. 1.00 has wrong rewards:
- Summer forage reward was 5 x Red cabbage, but it should be 5 x Red cabbage seed -> fixed in ver 1.01
- Fall crops reward was 3 x Starfruits, but is should be 3 x Starfruits seeds -> fixed in ver 1.01
- Garden reward was 2 x Elvish jewery (artefact), but is should be Heater -> fixed in ver 1.01
Rest of rewards are tested and is 100% fine.

Ver 1.00 and 1.01 has included Slimejack and Void salmon, which we can get only after finish Community center -> fixed in ver 1.02 where I just delete this 2 fish from Specialty fish bundle.[b]
[/b]

[u][b]INSTALL:[/b][/u]
To install replace the Bundles.xnb in the "Stardew Valley\Content\Data" folder. 
I would suggest creating a backup of the original.

[u][b]NOTE:[/b][/u]
Bundles are for English language in game.
But if you like play with this mod and with your language in game you can! (You will just don't have your language bundle name but it will be 'Bundle 1' 'Bundle 2' etc.)
Just download my file 'Bundles' and change file name to your language:
for german to -> Bundles.de-DE
for spanish to -> Bundles.es-ES
for chinese to -> Bundles.zh-CN
for japaniese to -> Bundles.ja-JP
for portugise/brazillian to -> Bundles.pt-BR
for russian to -> Bundles.ru-RU
